ideas: Who they are and what their job involves
The skills or attitude that make them stand out
A time you saw them at their best

phrases.phrase: at the top of their game

phrases.meaning: have strong knowledge of their field
feel satisfied by doing something well

model: I'd like to describe my dentist, Dr Hoa, who runs a small clinic near my office in District 3. I started going there about four years ago, which was when I had a terrible toothache, and I've never switched since. She's someone who's really at the top of her game. First of all, she clearly knows her stuff. Whenever she explains a problem, she shows me the X-ray on a screen and tells me exactly what's happening, which makes me trust her completely. Her attention to detail is second to none, too; she checks everything twice before she finishes. But what impresses me most is how she treats patients. I used to be terrified of dentists, and she has this calm way of talking that puts you at ease almost immediately. The moment I remember best was last year, when I cracked a tooth on a Sunday evening, right before an important job interview. I texted the clinic, not really expecting a reply, and she actually opened up early on Monday morning just for me. She worked under pressure, fixed it in forty minutes, and I made it to my interview on time. That's a dentist who really goes the extra mile. These days she's training two young dentists who've just joined the clinic, and you can see she takes pride in passing on her skills. Honestly, I think everyone should find a professional like her.
